title: Each batch merge mails every live session to refresh
why: Owner 09:57 CST Nov 13 (via the retrospective): "we need to have some sort of auto update upon merge or something ... to ensure checkouts / sessions stay current". Start and owner prompts are the only refresh points today.
note: Group "sessions stay current": grants-read-from-main (done, #2978), fast-forward-clean-start (#3141), cloud-hooks-stale-copy (#3020), roadmap-ref-fresh-before-verdict, and this step. Shape (retrospective proposal; triage pick, undo: drop this step): at each batch merge, the merge sends one mail to every live session: "main moved to <sha>; refresh". Each session reruns the install refresh and fast-forwards a clean checkout (c36 shape). The same mail carries the role-text notice from step role-text-follows-ruling: one mail per merge. Rulings between merges arrive through roadmap-ref-fresh-before-verdict. Done when: a test merge mails two live sessions and both report the new sha.
